title: Dune: Spice Wars
provenance: Reported by xcagricolak (highball#206, 2026-09-26), Apple M3, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.9.35, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r7, DXMT mode with AVX advertised: an 'OpenGL Error' dialog, the application was unable to create an OpenGL context, OpenGL 3.2+ is required. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported not starting: the game's OpenGL renderer asks for a context macOS's OpenGL cannot provide, and the switch Highball sets for 3.2 core contexts (CX_FWD_COMPAT_GL_CTX) was in place. Whether the game can be made to use its DirectX renderer instead, which would go through DXMT, is being asked on the report.

knownIssues.symptom: 'OpenGL Error: unable to create an OpenGL context, OpenGL 3.2+ is required' at launch (reported on an M3, highball#206).
knownIssues.cause: the game's OpenGL path asks for a context macOS does not offer; not looked at beyond the dialog yet.
knownIssues.fix: none confirmed. If Steam offers a DirectX launch choice for it, that is the thing to try.
